verdict.rationale: Omarchy ships its own `omarchy` CLI for controlling the system, which can be scripted (for example `omarchy reminder 7 'Tea ready'`, `omarchy-snapshot create`). It also bundles agent harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code) that it invites users to 'put to work on your computer.' However, nothing documents a dedicated automation or scripting tool for repetitive tasks, and the reminder is a one-off countdown, not a recurring schedule. Missing for 10: a documented built-in automation/macro or scheduling tool, recurring task scheduling, documented workflows for automating repetitive tasks, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can automate repetitive tasks using a built-in automation/scripting tool

citations.quote: you can also control it through the `omarchy` CLI. This is particularly helpful when you're having an AI agent work with you on customization or configuration.
You can also use the cli with `omarchy reminder 7 'Tea ready'`.
Pick your favorite, sign in, and put it to work on your computer.
